34900.meaning1: sake of hearing a sermon; purpose of hearing the teaching

examples.text: tesu ariyasāvakānaṃ dve'y'eva kiccāni ahesuṃ. purebhattaṃ dānaṃ denti, pacchābhattaṃ gandhamāl'ādihatthā vatthabhesajjapānak'ādīni gāhāpetvā dhammassavan'atthāya gacchanti.
ekasmiñ'hi kāle satthari āḷavinagaraṃ upanissāya agg'āḷave cetiye viharante bahū upāsakā upāsikā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo ca vihāraṃ dhammassavan'atthāya gacchanti, divā dhammassavanaṃ hoti.

34902.meaning1: in accordance with the teaching; following the teaching; in line with the teaching

examples.text: paṇḍito, bhikkhave, pukkusāti kulaputto paccapādi dhammass'ānudhammaṃ, na ca maṃ dhamm'ādhikaraṇaṃ vihesesi.
tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo'ti? paṇḍito, bhikkhave, bāhiyo dārucīriyo paccapādi dhammass'ānudhammaṃ, na ca maṃ dhamm'ādhikaraṇaṃ vihesesi. parinibbuto, bhikkhave, bāhiyo dārucīriyo'ti.

34903.meaning1: lord of the Dhamma; master of reality

examples.text: so h'āvuso, bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passati, cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto, vattā pavattā, atthassa ninnetā, amatassa dātā, dhammassāmī tathāgato
vanappagumbe yatha phussit'agge, gimhānamāse paṭhamasmiṃ gimhe, tath'ūpamaṃ dhammavaraṃ adesayi, nibbānagāmiṃ paramaṃ hitāya, idam'pi buddhe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.
varo varaññū varado var'āharo, anuttaro dhammavaraṃ adesayi, idam'pi buddhe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.

34906.meaning2: definition of ideas or states (opp. of vicikicchā)

34907.meaning1: who speaks about Dhamma; who speaks according to the teaching

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, lokena vivadāmi, loko'va mayā vivadati. na, bhikkhave, dhammavādī kenaci lokasmiṃ vivadati.
kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ

34908.meaning1: who talks the truth; who speaks according to reality

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, assalāyano māṇavo te brāhmaṇe etadavoca, samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo dhammavādī, dhammavādino ca pana duppaṭimantiyā bhavanti. n'āhaṃ sakkomi samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ asmiṃ vacane paṭimantetun'ti.

34909.meaningLit: discourse on the question about speaking of Dhamma

34910.meaning1: investigation of reality; examining states; analysing the teaching

examples.text: santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgaṃ, atthi me ajjhattaṃ dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgo'ti pajānāti
yasmiñ'ca kho, bhikkhave, samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, kālo tasmiṃ samaye dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo vīriyasambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo pītisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya.

34911.meaning1: investigation of reality as an element of awakening; analysing the teaching as a factor of enlightenment
34911.commentary: (DNa) dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa pana atthi, bhikkhave, kusal'ākusalā dhammā… kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgā dhammā, tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro, ayam'āhāro anuppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattatī'ti evaṃ uppādo hoti. (SNa) satta dhammā dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa uppādāya saṃvattanti, paripucchakatā vatthuvisadakiriyā indriyasamattapaṭipādanā duppaññapuggalaparivajjanā paññavantapuggalasevanā gambhīrañāṇacariyapaccavekkhaṇā tadadhimuttatā'ti.

examples.text: yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhu tathā sato viharanto taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya pavicinati pavicarati parivīmaṃsam'āpajjati, dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti.
yasmiñ'ca kho, bhikkhave, samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, kālo tasmiṃ samaye dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo vīriyasambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo pītisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya.

34912.meaning1: pondering about mental phenomena; contemplating things

examples.text: rūpavicāro loke… saddavicāro loke… gandhavicāro loke… rasavicāro loke… phoṭṭhabbavicāro loke… dhammavicāro loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etth'esā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccaṃ.

34913.meaning1: thoughts about the Dhamma; thinking about the teaching

examples.text: tasmiṃ pahīne tasmiṃ byantīkate ath'āparaṃ dhammavitakka-avasissati. so hoti samādhi na c'eva santo na ca paṇīto nappaṭippassaddhaladdho na ekodibhāv'ādhigato sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagato hoti.
so tehi dhammavitakkehi divasaṃ atināmeti, riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, n'ānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ.

34914.meaning1: thoughts about the Dhamma are left; contemplation of the teaching remains; (comm) imperfections of insight remain

examples.text: tasmiṃ pahīne tasmiṃ byantīkate ath'āparaṃ dhammavitakk'āvasissati.

34915.meaning1: thoughts about the Dhamma are left; contemplation of the teaching remains; (comm) imperfections of insight remain

examples.text: tasmiṃ pahīne tasmiṃ byantīkate santi adhicittam'anuyuttassa bhikkhuno sukhumasahagatā upakkilesā ñātivitakko janapadavitakko anavaññattipaṭisaṃyutto vitakko, tam'enaṃ sacetaso bhikkhu dabbajātiko pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti. tasmiṃ pahīne tasmiṃ byantīkate ath'āparaṃ dhammavitakko'vasissati.

34917.meaning1: teaching and training; doctrine and discipline
34917.commentary: (SNa) imaṃ dhammavinayan'ti imaṃ dhammañ'ca vinayañ'ca. ubhayam'p'etaṃ sāsanass'eva nāmaṃ.

examples.text: evam'evaṃ kho pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā na āyataken'eva aññāpaṭivedho

evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ manussattaṃ labhati. evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho. evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ tathāgatappavedito dhammavinayo loke dibbati.

34918.meaning1: discrimination of mental phenomena; evaluation of mental processes; investigation of reality

examples.text: asso yathā bhadro kasāniviṭṭho, ātāpino saṃvegino bhavātha, saddhāya sīlena ca vīriyena ca, samādhinā dhammavinicchayena ca, sampannavijjācaraṇā patissatā, jahissatha dukkham'idaṃ anappakaṃ.

34919.meaning1: trained in the teaching; educated in the Dhamma

examples.text: ye c'ime opapātikā dhammavinītā sātirekāni catuvīsatisatasahassāni māgadhakā paricārakā abbhatītā kālaṅ'katā tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sot'āpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā.

34920.meaning1: change, fading and ending of mental phenomena; alteration, disappearance and cessation of thoughts

examples.text: dhammavipariṇāmavirāganirodhā dukkhā, bhikkhave, devamanussā viharanti. tathāgato ca kho, bhikkhave, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho rūpānaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavaṃ ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā na rūp'ārāmo na rūparato na rūpasammudito.
idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo lābhī c'eva hoti ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa lābhī ca adhipaññādhammavipassanāya.

34922.meaning1: who practices the teaching; who lives according to the Dhamma

examples.text: so tāya dhammapariyattiyā na divasaṃ atināmeti, n'āpi riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, anuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ. evaṃ kho, bhikkhu, bhikkhu dhammavihārī hoti.
iti kho, bhikkhu, desito mayā pariyattibahulo, desito paññattibahulo, desito sajjhāyabahulo, desito vitakkabahulo, desito dhammavihārī.
katamā dve? āmisavuddhi ca dhammavuddhi ca. imā kho, bhikkhave, dve vuddhiyo.

34924.meaning1: inspiration from the teaching; enthusiasm from the Dhamma
34924.commentary: (MNa) dhammavedan'ti aveccappasādassa hetuṃ odhiso kilesappahānaṃ paccavekkhato uppannaṃ vuttappakāram'eva vedanti evam'pi ettha attho veditabbo. (ANa) dhammavedan'ti pāḷiṃ nissāya uppannaṃ pītipāmojjaṃ.

examples.text: yathodhi kho pan'assa cattaṃ hoti vantaṃ muttaṃ pahīnaṃ paṭinissaṭṭhaṃ, so buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgatomhī'ti labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhamm'ūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.
ujugatacitto kho pana, mahānāma, ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhamm'ūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.
katamāni dve? āmisavepullañ'ca dhammavepullañ'ca. imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve vepullāni.

34926.commentary: (VINa) buddhavevacanāni vā'ti buddhassa vā pariyāyanāmāni… asakyaputtiyassa vā. tattha vaṇṇapaṭṭhāne āgataṃ nāmasahassaṃ upāligāthāsu (ma ni 2.76) nāmasataṃ aññāni ca guṇato labbhamānāni nāmāni buddhavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. sabbāni'pi dhammassa nāmāni dhammavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. esa nayo sabbattha.

34927.meaning2: understands the Dhamma; comprehends the teaching

34928.meaning1: practices the teaching; lives the Dhamma

examples.text: uttiṭṭhe nappamajjeyya, dhammaṃ sucaritaṃ care, dhammacārī sukhaṃ seti, asmiṃ loke paramhi ca.
dhammaṃ care yo'pi samuñjakaṃ care, dārañ'ca posaṃ dadam'appakasmiṃ, sataṃ sahassānaṃ sahassayāginaṃ, kalam'pi n'āgghanti tathāvidhassa te'ti.
so ārāmagato parisati dhammaṃ deseti, na taṃ parisaṃ ussādeti, na taṃ parisaṃ apasādeti, añña'd'atthu dhammiyā kathāya taṃ parisaṃ sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.
accāraddhamhi vīriyamhi, satthā loke anuttaro, vīṇ'opamaṃ karitvā me, dhammaṃ desesi cakkhumā, tass'āhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā, vihāsiṃ sāsane rato.

34930.meaning1: preaches the Dhamma; gives a Dhamma talk

examples.text: so saṅkhāya kulāni upasaṅkamati saṅkhāya nisīdati saṅkhāya dhammaṃ bhāsati saṅkhāya uccārapassāvaṃ sandhāreti
saṅghagato kho pana anānākathiko hoti atiracchānakathiko. sāmaṃ vā dhammaṃ bhāsati, paraṃ vā ajjhesati, ariyaṃ vā tuṇhībhāvaṃ n'ātimaññati.

34931.meaning1: gift of the teaching to a guest

examples.text: katamāni dve? āmis'ātitheyyañ'ca dhamm'ātitheyyañ'ca. imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve ātitheyyāni.

34933.commentary: (SNa) dhamm'ādāsan'ti dhammamayaṃ ādāsaṃ. (THIa) dhamm'ādāsaṃ avekkhiṃ'han'ti dhammamayaṃ ādāsaṃ addakkhiṃ apassiṃ ahaṃ.

examples.text: vihesā p'esā, ānanda, assa tathāgatassa. tasmā't'ih'ānanda, dhamm'ādāsaṃ nāma dhammapariyāyaṃ desessāmi, yena samannāgato ariyasāvako ākaṅkhamāno attanā'va attānaṃ byākareyya, khīṇanirayo'mhi
bhāvito me maggo, ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko amatagāmī, nibbānaṃ sacchikataṃ, dhamm'ādāsaṃ avekkhiṃhaṃ.

34934.meaning1: Dhamma discourse on the mirror of the Dhamma

34935.meaning1: legitimately and illegitimately; lawfully and unlawfully; legally and illegally
34935.commentary: (SNa) dhamm'ādhammenā'ti dhammena ca adhammena ca. (ANa) dhamm'ādhammenā'ti dasa-kusalakammapatha-dhammena'pi dasa-akusalakammapatha-adhammena'pi.

examples.text: idha pana, gāmaṇi, ekacco kāmabhogī dhamm'ādhammena bhoge pariyesati, sāhasena'pi asāhasena'pi. dhamm'ādhammena bhoge pariyesitvā sāhasena'pi asāhasena'pi attānaṃ sukheti pīṇeti saṃvibhajati puññāni karoti.

34936.meaning1: controversy about the teaching; technical points about the teaching
34936.commentary: (MNa) na ca maṃ dhamm'ādhikaraṇaṃ vihesesī'ti mañ'ca dhammakāraṇā na kilamesi, na punappunaṃ kathāpesī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo'ti? paṇḍito, bhikkhave, bāhiyo dārucīriyo paccapādi dhammass'ānudhammaṃ, na ca maṃ dhamm'ādhikaraṇaṃ vihesesi. parinibbuto, bhikkhave, bāhiyo dārucīriyo'ti.
paṇḍito, bhikkhave, pukkusāti kulaputto paccapādi dhammass'ānudhammaṃ, na ca maṃ dhamm'ādhikaraṇaṃ vihesesi.

34937.meaning1: taking the Dhamma as an authority; putting the teaching in charge

examples.text: passanti devā ca tathāgatā ca, lokasmiṃ bālaṃ visamaṃ carantaṃ, tasmā hi att'ādhipateyyako ca, lok'ādhipo ca nipako ca jhāyī, dhamm'ādhipo ca anudhammacārī, na hīyati saccaparakkamo muni.

34938.meaning2: respecting of Dhamma as one's guide

34939.meaning1: fact of taking Dhamma as an authority; putting the teaching in charge

examples.text: tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, ādhipateyyāni. katamāni tīṇi? att'ādhipateyyaṃ, lok'ādhipateyyaṃ, dhamm'ādhipateyyaṃ.
so dhammaṃ'y'eva adhipatiṃ karitvā akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti, sāvajjaṃ pajahati, anavajjaṃ bhāveti, suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, dhamm'ādhipateyyaṃ.

34940.commentary: (DNa) dhamm'ādhipateyyo'ti dhamm'ādhipatibhūto āgatabhāvena dhammavasen'eva sabbakiriyānaṃ karaṇena dhamm'ādhipateyyo hutvā.

examples.text: tena hi tvaṃ, tāta, dhammaṃ'y'eva nissāya dhammaṃ sakkaronto dhammaṃ garuṃ karonto dhammaṃ mānento dhammaṃ pūjento dhammaṃ apacāyamāno dhammaddhajo dhammaketu dhamm'ādhipateyyo dhammikaṃ rakkh'āvaraṇaguttiṃ saṃvidahassu antojanasmiṃ balakāyasmiṃ khattiyesu anuyantesu brāhmaṇagahapatikesu negamajānapadesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu migapakkhīsu.

ayaṃ vuccat'āvuso, bhikkhu rūp'ādhibhū, sadd'ādhibhū, gandh'ādhibhū, ras'ādhibhū, phoṭṭhabb'ādhibhū, dhamm'ādhibhū, adhibhū, anadhibhūto, adhibhosi te pāpake akusale dhamme saṃkilesike ponobbhavike sadare dukkhavipāke āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiye. evaṃ kho, āvuso, anavassuto hotī'ti.

34944.meaning1: overpowered by mental phenomena; overwhelmed by thoughts

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccat'āvuso, bhikkhu rūp'ādhibhūto, sadd'ādhibhūto, gandh'ādhibhūto, ras'ādhibhūto, phoṭṭhabb'ādhibhūto, dhamm'ādhibhūto, adhibhūto, anadhibhū, adhibhaṃsu naṃ pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṃkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā. evaṃ kho, āvuso, avassuto hoti.

34945.meaning1: disrespect towards the Dhamma; contempt for the teaching
34945.commentary: (VIN 2.5.6.4) dhamm'ānādariyaṃ nāma upasampannena paññattena vuccamāno kath'āyaṃ nasseyya vā vinasseyya vā antaradhāyeyya vā, taṃ vā na sikkhitu'kāmo anādariyaṃ karoti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

examples.text: anādariyaṃ nāma dve anādariyāni, puggal'ānādariyañ'ca dhamm'ānādariyañ'ca.

dhamme, bhikkhave, yoniso manasi karotha, dhamm'āniccatañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassatha. dhamme, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yoniso manasikaronto, dhamm'āniccatañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto dhammesu'pi nibbindati. nandikkhayā rāgakkhayo, rāgakkhayā nandikkhayo.

34947.meaning1: concern about teaching; compassion with regard to the teaching

examples.text: katamā dve? āmis'ānukampā ca dhamm'ānukampā ca. imā kho, bhikkhave, dve anukampā.

34948.meaning1: assistance with the Dhamma; support with the teaching

examples.text: taṃ mayaṃ āyasmato sāriputtassa dhamm'ojaṃ dhammabhogaṃ dhamm'ānuggahaṃ anussarāmā'ti.
dve'me, bhikkhave, anuggahā āmis'ānuggaho ca dhamm'ānuggaho ca. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ dvinnaṃ anuggahānaṃ yadidaṃ dhamm'ānuggaho.

34949.meaning1: in accordance with the teaching; following the teaching

examples.text: yo kho, ānanda, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā upāsako vā upāsikā vā dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno viharati sāmīcippaṭipanno anudhammacārī so tathāgataṃ sakkaroti garuṃ karoti māneti pūjeti apaciyati paramāya pūjāya
yato kho tvaṃ, māgaṇḍiya, sappurise bhajissasi tato tvaṃ, māgaṇḍiya, saddhammaṃ sossasi. yato kho tvaṃ, māgaṇḍiya, saddhammaṃ sossasi tato tvaṃ, māgaṇḍiya, dhamm'ānudhammaṃ paṭipajjissasi.

34951.meaning1: practice of the teaching according to the teaching; accordant following of the Dhamma

examples.text: so aparena samayena ariyadhammaṃ suṇāti, yoniso manasi karoti, dhamm'ānudhammaṃ paṭipajjati. so ariyadhammassavanaṃ āgamma yonisomanasikāraṃ dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipattiṃ asaṃsaṭṭho viharati kāmehi asaṃsaṭṭho akusalehi dhammehi.

34952.meaning1: practising correctly; following the teaching properly; practising the Dhamma properly
34952.meaningLit: practising the Dhamma according to the Dhamma
34952.commentary: (ANa) dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipannā'ti ariyadhammassa anudhammabhūtaṃ vipassanādhammaṃ paṭipannā. (ANa) dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno'ti navalok'uttaradhammassa anudhammaṃ saha sīlena pubbabhāgapaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno.

examples.text: catuppadāya ce'pi, bhikkhu, gāthāya attham'aññāya dhammam'aññāya dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno hoti bahussuto dhammadharo'ti alaṃ vacanāyā'ti.
na tāv'āhaṃ, pāpima, parinibbāyissāmi, yāva me bhikkhuniyo na sāvikā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā bahussutā dhammadharā dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipannā

34953.meaning1: practising the teaching according to the teaching; following the Dhamma accordingly

examples.text: evaṃ dhamm'ānudhammappaṭippannaṃ iminā'p'aṅgena samannāgataṃ satthāraṃ n'eva atīt'aṃse samanupassāma, na pan'eta'r'ahi, aññatra tena bhagavatā.
dhamm'ānupassanā nīvaraṇapabbaṃ

34955.meaning1: observing phenomena; who watches mental phenomena; (or) observing the nature of things

examples.text: kathañ'ca pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhamm'ānupassī viharati pañcasu nīvaraṇesu
yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhu anicc'ānupassī assasissāmī'ti sikkhati… dhammesu dhamm'ānupassī, bhikkhave, tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
tāyaṃ velāyan'ti tassaṃ vippakārakaraṇavelāyaṃ. imaṃ udānan'ti taṃ vippakāraṃ agaṇetvā assa agaṇanahetubhūtaṃ dhamm'ānubhāvadīpakaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi.

34958.meaning1: who has attained the path of stream entry through understanding the teaching
34958.commentary: (MNa) dhamm'ānusārino saddh'ānusārino'ti ime dve sot'āpattimaggaṭṭhā honti. yath'āha, katamo ca puggalo dhamm'ānusārī? yassa puggalassa sot'āpattiphala-sacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa paññ'indriyaṃ adhimattaṃ hoti, paññāvāhiṃ paññāpubbaṅ'gamaṃ ariyamaggaṃ bhāveti. ayaṃ vuccati puggalo dhamm'ānusārī.

examples.text: yassa kho, bhikkhave, ime dhammā evaṃ paññāya mattaso nijjhānaṃ khamanti, ayaṃ vuccati dhamm'ānusārī, okkanto sammattaniyāmaṃ, sappurisabhūmiṃ okkanto, vītivatto puthujjanabhūmiṃ
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ye te bhikkhū dhamm'ānusārino saddh'ānusārino, te'pi tiriyaṃ mārassa sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gamissanti.

34959.meaning1: who has attained the path of stream entry through understanding the teaching
34959.meaning2: acting in conformity with the Dhamma
34959.commentary: (MNa) dhammaṃ anussaratī'ti dhamm'ānusārī. dhammo'ti paññā, paññāpubbaṅ'gamaṃ maggaṃ bhāvetī'ti attho.

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, bhaddāli, api nu tvaṃ, bhaddāli, tasmiṃ samaye ubhatobhāgavimutto vā hosi paññāvimutto vā kāyasakkhi vā diṭṭhippatto vā saddhāvimutto vā dhamm'ānusārī vā saddh'ānusārī vā'ti?

34960.meaning1: recollection of (the qualities of) the teaching

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, mahānāma, ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya pajāya abyāpajjo viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno dhamm'ānussatiṃ bhāveti

34961.meaning1: following the Dhamma; acting according to the teaching
34961.meaning2: acting in conformity with the Dhamma

examples.text: ye ca kho samma'd'akkhāte, dhamme dhamm'ānuvattino, te janā pāram'essanti, maccudheyyaṃ suduttaraṃ.

34962.meaning1: complete comprehension of the Dhamma; total understanding of reality

examples.text: n'eva satimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na sahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na satasahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti purimaṃ dukkhakkhandhaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādiṇṇaṃ upanidhāya yadidaṃ sattakkhattuṃparamatā. evaṃ mahatthiyo kho, bhikkhave, dhamm'ābhisamayo, evaṃ mahatthiyo dhammacakkhupaṭilābho'ti.
dasavīsasahassānaṃ, dhamm'ābhisamayo ahu, ekadvinnaṃ abhisamayā, gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyā.

34964.meaning1: field of mental phenomena; realm of qualia

examples.text: cha bāhirāni āyatanāni veditabbānī'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? rūp'āyatanaṃ sadd'āyatanaṃ gandh'āyatanaṃ ras'āyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabb'āyatanaṃ dhamm'āyatanaṃ

34965.meaning1: based on mental phenomena; related to thought processes

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, ānanda, bhikkhu vedanāsu … citte … dhammesu dhamm'ānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. tassa dhammesu dhamm'ānupassino viharato dhamm'ārammaṇo vā uppajjati kāyasmiṃ pariḷāho, cetaso vā līnattaṃ, bahiddhā vā cittaṃ vikkhipati.

34966.meaning1: enjoying the Dhamma; taking pleasure in the Dhamma; fond of the teaching
34966.commentary: (DHPa) tattha nivāsanaṭṭhena samathavipassanādhammo ārāmo assā'ti dhamm'ārāmo. tasmiṃ'y'eva dhamme rato'ti dhammarato.

examples.text: dhamm'ārāmo dhammarato, dhammaṃ anuvicintayaṃ, dhammaṃ anussaraṃ bhikkhu, saddhammā na parihāyati.

34967.meaning1: enjoying mental phenomena; taking pleasure in thought

examples.text: kāyo kho, māgaṇḍiya, phoṭṭhabb'ārāmo phoṭṭhabbarato… mano kho, māgaṇḍiya, dhamm'ārāmo dhammarato dhammasammudito. so tathāgatassa danto gutto rakkhito saṃvuto, tassa ca saṃvarāya dhammaṃ deseti.

so pana dhamm'āsanato otaranto dhammakathiko viya, nisseṇito otaranto puriso viya, ca dve ca hatthe dve ca pāde pasāretvā ṭhitako'va mātukucchisambhavena kenaci asucinā amakkhito suddho visado kāsikavatthe nikkhittamaṇiratanaṃ viya jotayanto mātukucchito nikkhami.

34969.commentary: (VIN 2.5.8.9) dhammikānan'ti dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena katattā dhammā etesu atthī'ti dhammikāni, tesaṃ dhammikānaṃ catunnaṃ saṅghakammānaṃ.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu dhammikānaṃ kammānaṃ chandaṃ datvā pacchā khīyanadhammaṃ āpajjeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
katamañ'ca, gahapati, atthisukhaṃ? idha, gahapati, kulaputtassa bhogā honti uṭṭhānavīriy'ādhigatā bāhābalaparicitā sed'āvakkhittā dhammikā dhammaladdhā.

34970.commentary: (MNa) dhammo assa atthī'ti dhammiko. (MNa) dhammena caratī'ti dhammiko, ñāyena samena vattatī'ti attho.

examples.text: sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, rājā hoti cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato. tass'imāni satta ratanāni bhavanti
na attahetu na parassa hetu, na puttam'icche na dhanaṃ na raṭṭhaṃ, na iccheyya adhammena samiddhim'attano, sa sīlavā paññavā dhammiko siyā.
atha kho bhagavā saccakaṃ nigaṇṭhaputtaṃ etadavoca, yā'pi kho te esā, aggivessana, purimā kāyabhāvanā bhāsitā sā'pi ariyassa vinaye no dhammikā kāyabhāvanā.
katamā dve? āmis'iddhi ca dhamm'iddhi ca. imā kho, bhikkhave, dve iddhiyo.

34978.meaning1: righteous; religious; moral; related to the Dhamma

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā bhikkhū nibbānapaṭisaṃyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti
kathañ'hi no siyā, bhante! idān'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya amatena abhisitto'ti.

34979.meaning2: acting in accordance with dhamma, with the rule

34980.meaning1: with a Dhamma talk; with a religious discourse; with a spiritual sermon

examples.text: so bhuttāvī anumodati, na taṃ bhattaṃ garahati, na aññaṃ bhattaṃ paṭikaṅkhati, añña'd'atthu dhammiyā kathāya taṃ parisaṃ sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.
kathañ'hi no siyā, bhante! idān'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya amatena abhisitto'ti.

34982.meaning1: Dhamma talk; religious discourse; spiritual sermon

examples.text: alattha no ajja bhagavato sammukhā dhammiṃ kathaṃ savanāyā'ti?
cirassutā no, āvuso ānanda, bhagavato sammukhā dhammī kathā. sādhu mayaṃ, āvuso ānanda, labheyyāma bhagavato sammukhā dhammiṃ kathaṃ savanāyā'ti.

34983.meaning1: righteous; religious; moral; related to the Dhamma
34983.commentary: (DNa) dhammī'ti dhammasaṃyuttā. (MNa) dhammī vā kathā'ti dasakathāvatthunissitā vā dhammī kathā. (UDa) dhammī kathā'ti catusaccadhammato anapetā kathā, pavatti-nivatti-paridīpinī dhammadesanā'ti attho. dasakathāvatthusaṅkhātāpi hi dhammakathā tadekadesā evā'ti.

examples.text: alattha no ajja bhagavato sammukhā dhammiṃ kathaṃ savanāyā'ti?
cirassutā no, āvuso ānanda, bhagavato sammukhā dhammī kathā. sādhu mayaṃ, āvuso ānanda, labheyyāma bhagavato sammukhā dhammiṃ kathaṃ savanāyā'ti.

34984.meaning1: having the nature (of); characterized (by); marked (with); with the fundamental attribute (of)

examples.text: na tvaṃ bāle pajānāsi, yathā arahataṃ vaco, aniccā sabbasaṅkhārā, uppādavayadhammino, uppajjitvā nirujjhanti, tesaṃ vūpasamo sukho'ti.
byādhidhammā jarādhammā, atho maraṇadhammino, yathā dhammā tathā sattā, jigucchanti puthujjanā.

34986.meaning1: Dhamma discourse (about); discussion about the teaching (in)
34986.commentary: (MNa) na ca me evarūpī dhammīkathā sutapubbā'ti… evarūpī dhammakathā na sutapubbā'ti vadati

examples.text: n'esā bhoto ānandassa kathā dullabhā bhavissati pacchā'pi savanāya. sādhu vata bhavantaṃ'y'eva ānandaṃ paṭibhātu sake ācariyake dhammīkathā'ti. tena hi, sandaka, suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi, bhāsissāmī'ti.

34987.meaning1: summary of the teaching; teaching in brief; Dhamma point

examples.text: atthi kho, mahārāja, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena cattāro dhamm'uddesā uddiṭṭhā, ye ahaṃ ñatvā ca disvā ca sutvā ca agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.

34988.meaning2: agitation about whether a state is of the noble path or not

34989.meaning1: seized by agitation regarding the Dhamma; (comm) seized by agitation about the corruptions of insight
34989.commentary: (ANa) dhamm'uddhaccaviggahitan'ti samathavipassanādhammesu dasa-vipassan'upakkilesa-saṅkhātena uddhaccena viggahitaṃ, suggahitan'ti attho.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhuno dhamm'uddhaccaviggahitaṃ mānasaṃ hoti. hoti so, āvuso, samayo yaṃ taṃ cittaṃ ajjhattam'eva santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodi hoti samādhiyati. tassa maggo sañjāyati. so taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.

34990.commentary: (ANa) dhamm'uposathan'ti sahatantikaṃ navalok'uttaradhammaṃ ārabbha upavutthattā ayaṃ uposatho dhamm'uposatho'ti vutto.

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, visākhe, ariyasāvako dhamm'uposathaṃ upavasati, dhammena saddhiṃ saṃvasati, dhammañ'c'assa ārabbha cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmojjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti.

34991.meaning2: support for the Dhamma or True Idea

34992.meaning1: concerning the teaching; regarding the Dhamma; for the Dhamma; (comm) connected with the Pāli text and the commentary
34992.commentary: (VINa) dhamm'ūpasañhito'ti pāḷinissito, ubhayenā'pi vivaṭṭ'ūpanissitam'eva vadati. (ANa) dhamm'ūpasañhitan'ti pāḷiñ'ca aṭṭhakathañ'ca nissāya uppannaṃ.

examples.text: dhammo nāma buddhabhāsito, sāvakabhāsito, isibhāsito, devatābhāsito, atth'ūpasañhito, dhamm'ūpasañhito.

34993.meaning1: connected with the teaching; concerning the Dhamma; for the Dhamma

examples.text: ujugatacitto kho pana, mahānāma, ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhamm'ūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.
yathodhi kho pan'assa cattaṃ hoti vantaṃ muttaṃ pahīnaṃ paṭinissaṭṭhaṃ, so buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgatomhī'ti labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhamm'ūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.

34994.meaning1: providing an idea; arranging something to contemplate
34994.meaning2: presenting of ideas, images, or of the teachings

examples.text: dhamm'ūpahāro nāma nerayikassa nirayakathaṃ katheti, imaṃ sutvā uttasitvā marissatī'ti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. taṃ sutvā uttasati, āpatti thull'accayassa.

34995.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of dhamma

examples.text: parosahassaṃ kho pan'assa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīr'aṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā. so imaṃ pathaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.
asāhasena dhammena, samena nayatī pare, dhammassa gutto medhāvī, dhammaṭṭho'ti pavuccati.

34996.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of dhamma

examples.text: yo vītarāgo vītarāgesu dadāti dānaṃ, dhammena laddhaṃ supasannacitto, abhisaddahaṃ kammaphalaṃ uḷāraṃ, taṃ ve dānaṃ āmisadānānam'aggan'ti.

34997.commentary: (SNa) diṭṭhe dhamm'esa vipāko'ti tasmiṃ nibbattabhavane diṭṭhe dhamme esa vipāko.

examples.text: parato āsīsare bālā, tam'pi tesaṃ na labbhati, diṭṭhe dhamm'esa vipāko, samparāye ca duggatī'ti.
katamā dve? āmis'esanā ca dhamm'esanā ca. imā kho, bhikkhave, dve esanā.

34999.meaning1: one remains among phenomena, closely observing the phenomena
34999.commentary: (PM) kathaṃ dhammesu dhamm'ānupassī viharati? idh'ekacco ṭhapetvā kāyaṃ ṭhapetvā vedanaṃ ṭhapetvā cittaṃ tadavasese dhamme aniccato anupassati, no niccato, dukkhato anupassati, no sukhato, anattato anupassati, no attato, nibbindati, no nandati, virajjati, no rajjati, nirodheti, no samudeti, paṭinissajjati, no ādiyati. aniccato anupassanto niccasaññaṃ pajahati, dukkhato anupassanto sukhasaññaṃ pajahati, anattato anupassanto attasaññaṃ pajahati, nibbindanto nandiṃ pajahati, virajjanto rāgaṃ pajahati, nirodhento samudayaṃ pajahati, paṭinissajjanto ādānaṃ pajahati. imehi sattahi ākārehi te dhamme anupassati. dhammā upaṭṭhānaṃ, no sati.
